target: acceptances 2+4+7 — the spec-authoring stage must actually run the classifier. Wiring tracker without wiring skills/spec leaves the workflow unaware the gate exists.
cmd: f="$PLUGIN_ROOT/skills/spec/SKILL.md"; calls=$(grep -c "tracker.sh irreversible" "$f"); split=$(grep -c "tracker.sh split" "$f"); ovr=$(grep -c "irreversible-override" "$f"); printf '{"calls":%s,"split":%s,"override":%s}' "$calls" "$split" "$ovr"
